FBA: Console application.description: Create a .NET 10 file-based console application in a new C# file.

FBA: Minimal web application.description: Create a .NET 10 ASP.NET Core file-based application in a new C# file.

FBA: MSBuild property directive.description: Set an MSBuild property before the C# code: #:property Name=value.

FBA: NuGet package directive.description: Reference a NuGet package before the C# code; replace both the package name and version.

FBA: Disable Native AOT.description: Disable Native AOT publishing for this file-based application.

FBA: Unix shebang.description: Insert as the first line for Unix execution with argument forwarding; requires env -S, LF, no BOM, and executable permission.

FBA: Simple Unix shebang.description: Fallback for Unix systems without env -S; requires LF, no BOM, and executable permission. dotnet may consume CLI-style arguments.

FBA: SDK directive.description: Select an SDK before the C# code. Additional packages may be needed by the application.

FBA: Target framework directive.description: Set the target framework before the C# code; file-based applications require .NET 10 or later.

FBA: Nullable reference types.description: Configure nullable reference types before the C# code.

FBA: Source file paths.description: Read and display optional original entry-point source paths; they may be unavailable after publishing.

FBA: Minimal API text endpoint.description: Add a text endpoint to an ASP.NET Core application before app.Run().

FBA: Minimal API JSON endpoint.description: Add a JSON endpoint with a timestamp and random integer before app.Run(); use JSON source generation when publishing with Native AOT.

FBA: Project reference directive.description: Reference another project before the C# code; replace the relative project path.

FBA: Include source file directive.description: Include a C# file containing declarations, not top-level statements; requires .NET SDK 10.0.300 or later.

FBA: MSBuild environment property with f.description: Set a build-time property from an environment variable with a fallback; insert before the C# code.

FBA: Runtime environment variable with f.description: Read an environment variable at runtime and use a fallback when it is unset.

FBA: JSON and environment configuration.description: Build JSON configuration with environment overrides; requires the Web SDK/shared framework or configuration packages.

FBA: JSON source generation context.description: Append a JSON source generation context after all top-level statements; replace JsonModel with the type to serialize.

FBA: Serialize JSON with generated metad.description: Serialize using a generated JSON context for Native AOT; match the value, context, and generated type metadata.

FBA: Cancellable periodic loop.description: Run asynchronous periodic work until Ctrl+C, dispose resources, and remove the console cancellation handler.
